text:
Predicates:
TranslatedFrom(x, y) ::: x is translated from y.
PublishedBy(x, y) ::: x is published by y.
InLanguage(x, y) ::: x is in language y.
Premises:
∀x (PublishedBy(x, y) → InLanguage(x, English)) ::: All books published by New Vessel Press are in English.
PublishedBy(neapolitanChronicles, newVesselPress) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is published by New Vessel Press.
TranslatedFrom(neapolitanChronicles, Italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles was translated from Italian.
PublishedBy(palaceOfFlies, newVesselPress) ::: Palace of Flies is published by New Vessel Press.
Conclusion:
TranslatedFrom(palaceOfFlies, Italian) ::: Palace of Flies was translated from Italian.
